lines:
Task #186 trap, cost a live-profile outage. `initialize_history_index` re-runs the legacy migration on every open: it reads the legacy stream `chat.local` and `copy_legacy_chat` requires each migrated Chat to equal its segment. Those are separate streams with separate retention windows, so a release tombstones one side only, and payload equality refused the profile with "partially migrated Chat history differs from its legacy source" — the app would not open.

Fix: tolerate a payload difference when either side is a released tombstone (`is_pruned`); the kind must still match, and any other difference is still refused instead of silently rebuilding the Chat. Test: runtime::history::tests::a_released_payload_does_not_refuse_the_legacy_migration (verified to fail on the old predicate).

Lesson: after any payload-level change, open the real profile (`DesktopRuntime::open`) and project every Chat; fixtures did not catch this.
